idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome. Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

tool_schemas.name: get_ci_status
tool_schemas.description: Get the status of a CI run.

tool_schemas.description: Wait (up to max_wait_s, default 900) for a CI run to finish and return its result.

tool_schemas.name: list_ci_runs
tool_schemas.description: List CI runs, optionally for a branch or commit.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome, including when the original failed partway (the retry then reports what committed). Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

tool_schemas.name: merge_pr

args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body: The nightly build failed because tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but src/money.py used ROUND_HALF_UP. This changes round_money to quantize with ROUND_HALF_EVEN, so 2.675 -> 2.68 and 2.665 -> 2.66. CI passed on the branch.
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

trace.error_message: Request to open_pr timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
Done. Here's what I did:

1. **Investigated** the nightly failure: `tests/test_money.py` expects `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")` (banker's rounding per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`.
2. **Created branch** `fix/bankers-rounding` off main.
3. **Committed the fix**: changed `round_money` to quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (2.675 → 2.68, 2.665 → 2.66).
4. **Ran CI** — run `ci-0001` passed.
5. **Opened PR #101** against `main` requesting review from **alex** (the PR-creation call timed out, but the PR was created; I then verified it existed and successfully requested alex's review).

The PR now just needs alex's code-owner approval before merging to main.
